items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He said, what, Mr. Tarnes? He said, play on that banjo you got there. He said, I can play, Mr. Tarnes. He said, you can't play nothing.

ctx.x: Okay, go ahead. Ask them about the tranchina.

Oh, the tranchina. Yeah, after they played there a while, the tranchina, they kept on, so they turned to the boys and they said, Dad can't play no banjo like this, Dad can't play no banjo like that. And, um, always banging on the set. So, at the time, they got rid of the band. They told tranchina, say, my boy, what do you call yourself doing? I said, what, Mr. Tarnes? He said, play on that banjo you got there. He said, I can play, Mr. Tarnes. He said, you can't play nothing. He said, give me that banjo. And…
Ask him about Tony Jackson. He wanted to tell us about Tony Jackson.
